blog_posts.title: कुंडली में मंगल दोष
blog_posts.summary: मांगलिक दोष क्या है और इसके निवारण
blog_posts.summary_en: What Manglik Dosha is and its remedies
blog_posts.body:
जब मंगल ग्रह कुंडली के पहले, चौथे, सातवें, आठवें या बारहवें भाव में स्थित होता है, तो इसे मंगल दोष या मांगलिक दोष कहा जाता है।

यह मुख्य रूप से विवाह में देरी या बाधा से जुड़ा माना जाता है। हनुमान जी की पूजा, मंगल के मंत्र का जाप और उपयुक्त कुंडली मिलान से इसका प्रभाव कम होता है।

घबराएं नहीं—अधिकांश मंगल दोष सरल उपायों से शांत हो जाते हैं।
blog_posts.body_en:
When Mars (Mangal) is placed in the first, fourth, seventh, eighth or twelfth house of the Kundli, it is called Mangal Dosha or Manglik Dosha.

It is mainly associated with delays or obstacles in marriage. Worshipping Hanuman Ji, chanting the Mangal mantra and proper Kundli matching reduce its effects.

Don't panic—most cases of Mangal Dosha can be pacified with simple remedies.
blog_posts.author: पंडित अमन पांडे

blog_posts.title: अंक ज्योतिष से जानें अपना भाग्यांक
blog_posts.title_en: Discover Your Destiny Number Through Numerology
blog_posts.summary: जन्म तिथि से भाग्यांक निकालने की विधि
blog_posts.summary_en: How to calculate your destiny number from your date of birth
blog_posts.body:
भाग्यांक आपकी संपूर्ण जन्म तिथि (दिन, माह, वर्ष) के अंकों को जोड़कर निकाला जाता है। यह आपके जीवन के उद्देश्य और भाग्य को दर्शाता है।

उदाहरण के लिए, 22-01-2000 का भाग्यांक होगा 2+2+0+1+2+0+0+0 = 7। प्रत्येक भाग्यांक का अपना स्वामी ग्रह और गुण होता है।

अपने भाग्यांक को जानकर आप करियर, रिश्ते और निर्णयों में बेहतर मार्गदर्शन पा सकते हैं।
blog_posts.body_en:
Your destiny number (Bhagyank) is calculated by adding up all the digits of your full date of birth (day, month, year). It reflects your life's purpose and destiny.

For example, the destiny number for 22-01-2000 is 2+2+0+1+2+0+0+0 = 7. Each destiny number has its own ruling planet and qualities.

Knowing your destiny number can give you better guidance on career, relationships and decisions.
blog_posts.author: पंडित राजेश त्रिपाठी

blog_posts.title: रत्न धारण करने के नियम
blog_posts.summary: सही रत्न कैसे चुनें और कब पहनें
blog_posts.summary_en: How to choose the right gemstone and when to wear it
blog_posts.body:
रत्न ग्रहों की ऊर्जा को बढ़ाते हैं, इसलिए इन्हें बिना किसी योग्य ज्योतिषी की सलाह के धारण नहीं करना चाहिए।

प्रत्येक ग्रह का अपना रत्न होता है—सूर्य के लिए माणिक्य, चंद्र के लिए मोती, गुरु के लिए पुखराज इत्यादि। रत्न को सही धातु, सही उंगली और शुभ मुहूर्त में ही धारण करें।

रत्न धारण करने से पहले उसे गंगाजल और दूध से शुद्ध करना आवश्यक है।
blog_posts.body_en:
Gemstones amplify the energy of the planets, so they should never be worn without the advice of a qualified astrologer.

Every planet has its own gemstone—ruby (Manikya) for the Sun, pearl (Moti) for the Moon, yellow sapphire (Pukhraj) for Jupiter, and so on. Wear a gemstone only in the right metal, on the right finger and at an auspicious muhurat.

Before wearing a gemstone, it is essential to purify it with Gangajal and milk.
blog_posts.author: पंडित मनोहर शर्मा

blog_posts.title: पितृ दोष और उसके उपाय
blog_posts.summary: पितृ दोष के लक्षण और शांति के उपाय
blog_posts.summary_en: Signs of Pitra Dosha and remedies to pacify it
blog_posts.body:
पितृ दोष तब बनता है जब पूर्वजों की आत्मा असंतुष्ट रहती है या पितरों का उचित श्राद्ध नहीं होता। यह कुंडली में सूर्य और राहु के योग से भी दर्शाया जाता है।

पितृ दोष के कारण संतान, करियर और पारिवारिक सुख में बाधा आ सकती है। पितृ पक्ष में श्राद्ध, तर्पण और ब्राह्मण भोजन इसके प्रमुख उपाय हैं।

पूर्वजों का सम्मान और नियमित तर्पण से पितृ प्रसन्न होते हैं।
blog_posts.body_en:
Pitra Dosha arises when the souls of ancestors remain unsatisfied or when the proper Shraddh for the ancestors has not been performed. It is also indicated in the Kundli by a conjunction of the Sun and Rahu.

Pitra Dosha can create obstacles related to children, career and family happiness. Performing Shraddh, Tarpan and feeding Brahmins during Pitru Paksha are its main remedies.

Honouring your ancestors and performing regular Tarpan keeps them pleased.
blog_posts.author: आचार्य ब्रह्मेंद्र

blog_posts.title: शनि साढ़ेसाती: लक्षण और उपाय
blog_posts.title_en: Shani Sade Sati: Signs and Remedies
blog_posts.summary: शनि की साढ़ेसाती के प्रभाव और सरल उपाय
blog_posts.summary_en: Effects of Shani's Sade Sati and simple remedies
blog_posts.body:
शनि की साढ़ेसाती जीवन का वह दौर है जब शनि ग्रह चंद्र राशि से 12वें, पहले और दूसरे भाव में गोचर करते हैं। यह लगभग साढ़े सात वर्ष तक रहती है।

इस दौरान धैर्य, मेहनत और ईमानदारी सबसे बड़े सहायक होते हैं। हनुमान जी की उपासना, शनिवार को तेल का दान और गरीबों की सेवा से शनि शांत होते हैं।

याद रखें, साढ़ेसाती केवल कष्ट नहीं देती, बल्कि यह आपको परिपक्व और मजबूत भी बनाती है।
blog_posts.body_en:
Shani's Sade Sati is the phase of life when Saturn transits the 12th, 1st and 2nd houses from your Moon sign. It lasts for about seven and a half years.

During this time, patience, hard work and honesty are your greatest allies. Worshipping Hanuman Ji, donating oil on Saturdays and serving the poor help pacify Shani.

Remember, Sade Sati doesn't only bring hardship—it also makes you more mature and stronger.
blog_posts.author: पंडित अभिनव मिश्रा

blog_posts.title: वास्तु के अनुसार मुख्य द्वार
blog_posts.title_en: The Main Entrance According to Vastu
blog_posts.summary: घर के मुख्य द्वार की सही दिशा और सजावट
blog_posts.summary_en: The right direction and decor for your home's main entrance
blog_posts.body:
मुख्य द्वार को घर का मुख माना जाता है क्योंकि यहीं से ऊर्जा प्रवेश करती है। वास्तु के अनुसार उत्तर, पूर्व और उत्तर-पूर्व दिशा का द्वार सबसे शुभ होता है।

द्वार पर स्वस्तिक, ओम या शुभ-लाभ लगाना सकारात्मक ऊर्जा लाता है। द्वार के सामने कूड़ेदान या टूटी वस्तुएं नहीं रखनी चाहिए।

साफ-सुथरा और अच्छी तरह प्रकाशित मुख्य द्वार समृद्धि को आमंत्रित करता है।
blog_posts.body_en:
The main entrance is considered the face of the home, because this is where energy enters. According to Vastu, an entrance facing north, east or north-east is the most auspicious.

Placing a Swastik, Om or Shubh-Labh on the door brings positive energy. Dustbins or broken items should not be kept in front of the door.

A clean and well-lit main entrance invites prosperity.

blog_posts.summary: बृहस्पति की महादशा में जीवन के अवसर
blog_posts.body:
बृहस्पति यानी गुरु ग्रह ज्ञान, धन और भाग्य का कारक है। इसकी महादशा 16 वर्ष तक चलती है और शुभ स्थिति में यह जीवन में उन्नति लाती है।

इस दौरान शिक्षा, विवाह, संतान और आध्यात्मिक विकास के योग बनते हैं। पीला रंग धारण करना, गुरुवार का व्रत और केले के पेड़ की पूजा गुरु को बलवान बनाती है।

गुरु की कृपा से व्यक्ति समाज में सम्मान प्राप्त करता है।
blog_posts.body_en:
Brihaspati, or Guru (Jupiter), is the significator of knowledge, wealth and fortune. Its Mahadasha lasts for 16 years, and when well placed it brings progress in life.

During this period, opportunities arise for education, marriage, children and spiritual growth. Wearing yellow, fasting on Thursdays and worshipping the banana tree strengthen Jupiter.

With Guru's blessings, a person earns respect in society.

horoscopes.name: मेष
horoscopes.summary: मेष राशि के जातक साहसी, ऊर्जावान और नेतृत्व करने वाले होते हैं।
horoscopes.summary_en: Aries natives are courageous, energetic and natural leaders.
horoscopes.about:
मेष राशि, राशि चक्र की पहली राशि है जिसका प्रतीक मेढ़ा है। यह मंगल ग्रह द्वारा शासित अग्नि राशि है। मेष जातक अपनी गतिशील ऊर्जा, नेतृत्व गुणों और अग्रणी भावना के लिए जाने जाते हैं। ये स्वाभाविक नेता होते हैं जो जोखिम उठाने और नए क्षेत्रों में कदम रखने से नहीं डरते।

इस राशि के तहत जन्म लेने वाले लोग अपने उत्साह, साहस और दृढ़ संकल्प द्वारा पहचाने जाते हैं। वे हर काम में पहले रहने की प्रबल इच्छा रखते हैं।
horoscopes.about_en:
Aries is the first sign of the zodiac, symbolised by the ram. It is a fire sign ruled by Mars. Aries natives are known for their dynamic energy, leadership qualities and pioneering spirit. They are natural leaders who are not afraid to take risks and step into new territory.

People born under this sign are recognised by their enthusiasm, courage and determination. They have a strong desire to be first in everything they do.
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में मेष जातक भावुक, सीधे और कुछ हद तक अधिकारजताने वाले होते हैं। वे जल्दी प्रेम में पड़ते हैं और पहल करने से नहीं हिचकिचाते। उन्हें एक ऐसे साथी की जरूरत होती है जो उनकी ऊर्जा और स्वतंत्रता का सम्मान करे।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Aries natives are passionate, direct and somewhat possessive. They fall in love quickly and don't hesitate to take the initiative. They need a partner who respects their energy and independence.
horoscopes.compatible: सिंह, धनु, मिथुन और कुंभ राशि वाले मेष के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Leo, Sagittarius, Gemini and Aquarius are the most compatible signs for Aries.
horoscopes.career: मेष जातक ऐसे करियर में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं जहाँ नेतृत्व, नवाचार और चुनौती हो। वे तेज़ गति वाले वातावरण में फलते-फूलते हैं।
horoscopes.career_en: Aries natives excel in careers that involve leadership, innovation and challenge. They thrive in fast-paced environments.
horoscopes.career_paths: उद्यमिता, बिक्री, सैन्य सेवा, खेल, राजनीति, आपातकालीन सेवाएं और नेतृत्व भूमिकाएं।
horoscopes.career_paths_en: Entrepreneurship, sales, military service, sports, politics, emergency services and leadership roles.
horoscopes.health: मेष जातकों को अपने सिर पर विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए क्योंकि यह उनका शासक अंग है। उन्हें अपनी प्रचुर ऊर्जा को नियमित व्यायाम से नियंत्रित करना चाहिए। तनाव प्रबंधन और धैर्य विकास उनके समग्र स्वास्थ्य के लिए महत्वपूर्ण हैं।
horoscopes.health_en: Aries natives should pay special attention to the head, as it is their ruling body part. They should channel their abundant energy through regular exercise. Managing stress and developing patience are important for their overall health.

इस राशि के लोग दृढ़निश्चयी और मेहनती होते हैं। एक बार लक्ष्य तय करने के बाद वे उसे पाकर ही रहते हैं।
horoscopes.about_en:
Taurus is an earth sign ruled by Venus. Its symbol is the bull. Taurus natives are known for their stability, practicality and reliability. They enjoy life's comforts and have a deep appreciation of beauty.

People of this sign are determined and hardworking. Once they set a goal, they don't rest until they achieve it.
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में वृषभ जातक अत्यंत वफादार, रोमांटिक और देखभाल करने वाले होते हैं। वे स्थायी और गहरे रिश्ते चाहते हैं। उन्हें सुरक्षा और भावनात्मक स्थिरता की आवश्यकता होती है।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Taurus natives are extremely loyal, romantic and caring. They seek lasting, deep relationships. They need security and emotional stability.
horoscopes.compatible: कन्या, मकर, कर्क और मीन राशि वाले वृषभ के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।

horoscopes.career: वृषभ जातक वित्त, कला, संगीत, खाद्य उद्योग और रियल एस्टेट में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं। उनकी व्यावहारिक सोच और धैर्य उन्हें सफल बनाती है।

People of this sign are social, clever and always looking for new information. Their dual nature makes them interesting and sometimes unpredictable.

horoscopes.love_en: In love, Gemini natives seek mental stimulation and variety. They look for an intelligent, fun partner with whom they can exchange ideas.
horoscopes.compatible: तुला, कुंभ, मेष और सिंह राशि वाले मिथुन के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Libra, Aquarius, Aries and Leo are the most compatible signs for Gemini.
horoscopes.career: मिथुन जातक पत्रकारिता, मीडिया, शिक्षण, विज्ञापन और व्यापार में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं। उनकी संचार क्षमता उनकी सबसे बड़ी शक्ति है।

People of this sign give their home and family the highest priority. Their sixth sense is very sharp.
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में कर्क जातक गहराई से प्यार करते हैं और अपने साथी की पूरी देखभाल करते हैं। वे एक स्थायी और भावनात्मक रूप से संतोषजनक रिश्ता चाहते हैं।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Cancer natives love deeply and take complete care of their partner. They want a lasting, emotionally fulfilling relationship.
horoscopes.compatible: वृश्चिक, मीन, वृषभ और कन्या राशि वाले कर्क के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Scorpio, Pisces, Taurus and Virgo are the most compatible signs for Cancer.
horoscopes.career: कर्क जातक स्वास्थ्य सेवा, शिक्षा, सामाजिक कार्य, खाद्य उद्योग और रियल एस्टेट में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं।
horoscopes.career_en: Cancer natives excel in healthcare, education, social work, the food industry and real estate.
horoscopes.career_paths: नर्सिंग, शिक्षण, सामाजिक कार्य, खाद्य उद्योग, रियल एस्टेट, मनोविज्ञान और बाल देखभाल।
horoscopes.career_paths_en: Nursing, teaching, social work, the food industry, real estate, psychology and childcare.
horoscopes.health: कर्क जातकों को पेट और पाचन तंत्र पर विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए। भावनात्मक तनाव अक्सर शारीरिक समस्याओं में बदल जाता है। ध्यान और संतुलित आहार लाभकारी होता है।
horoscopes.health_en: Cancer natives should pay special attention to the stomach and digestive system. Emotional stress often turns into physical problems. Meditation and a balanced diet are beneficial.

horoscopes.name: सिंह
horoscopes.summary: सिंह राशि के जातक आत्मविश्वासी, उदार और नेतृत्व करने वाले होते हैं।
horoscopes.summary_en: Leo natives are confident, generous and natural leaders.
horoscopes.about:
सिंह राशि, सूर्य द्वारा शासित अग्नि तत्व की राशि है जिसका प्रतीक शेर है। सिंह जातक अपने आत्मविश्वास, करिश्मे और उदार स्वभाव के लिए जाने जाते हैं। ये जन्मजात नेता होते हैं जो हमेशा केंद्र में रहना पसंद करते हैं।

इस राशि के लोग दयालु, उत्साही और सृजनात्मक होते हैं। इनकी उपस्थिति मात्र से माहौल रोशन हो जाता है।
horoscopes.about_en:
Leo is a fire sign ruled by the Sun, symbolised by the lion. Leo natives are known for their confidence, charisma and generous nature. They are born leaders who always like to be the centre of attention.

People of this sign are kind, enthusiastic and creative. Their mere presence lights up the room.
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में सिंह जातक रोमांटिक, भावुक और अपने साथी को राजा-रानी जैसा महसूस कराने वाले होते हैं। वे एक ऐसे साथी चाहते हैं जो उनकी प्रशंसा करे और उनके साथ बराबरी से चले।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Leo natives are romantic, passionate and make their partner feel like royalty. They want a partner who admires them and walks alongside them as an equal.
horoscopes.compatible: मेष, धनु, मिथुन और तुला राशि वाले सिंह के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Aries, Sagittarius, Gemini and Libra are the most compatible signs for Leo.
horoscopes.career: सिंह जातक मनोरंजन, राजनीति, प्रबंधन, शिक्षा और कला में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं। प्रसिद्धि और पहचान उन्हें प्रेरित करती है।
horoscopes.career_en: Leo natives excel in entertainment, politics, management, education and the arts. Fame and recognition motivate them.
horoscopes.career_paths: अभिनय, राजनीति, प्रबंधन, शिक्षण, फैशन, इवेंट मैनेजमेंट और उद्यमिता।
horoscopes.career_paths_en: Acting, politics, management, teaching, fashion, event management and entrepreneurship.
horoscopes.health: सिंह जातकों को हृदय और पीठ पर विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए। नियमित व्यायाम और स्वस्थ जीवनशैली उनके लिए आवश्यक है।
horoscopes.health_en: Leo natives should pay special attention to the heart and back. Regular exercise and a healthy lifestyle are essential for them.

horoscopes.name: कन्या
horoscopes.summary: कन्या राशि के जातक विश्लेषणात्मक, व्यवस्थित और विवरण पर ध्यान देने वाले होते हैं।
horoscopes.summary_en: Virgo natives are analytical, organised and attentive to detail.
horoscopes.about:
कन्या राशि, बुध ग्रह द्वारा शासित पृथ्वी तत्व की राशि है। इसका प्रतीक कुँवारी कन्या है। कन्या जातक अपनी विश्लेषणात्मक सोच, व्यावहारिकता और परिश्रम के लिए जाने जाते हैं। ये अत्यंत सूक्ष्म विवरणों पर ध्यान देते हैं।

इस राशि के लोग सेवाभावी, विनम्र और पूर्णतावादी होते हैं। इनका तार्किक दृष्टिकोण इन्हें समस्याओं को सुलझाने में माहिर बनाता है।
horoscopes.about_en:
Virgo is an earth sign ruled by Mercury. Its symbol is the virgin maiden. Virgo natives are known for their analytical thinking, practicality and hard work. They pay attention to the finest details.

People of this sign are service-minded, humble and perfectionists. Their logical approach makes them experts at solving problems.
negative: दूसरों की मदद में खुद को भूलते हैं
निर्णय लेने में समय लगता है
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में कन्या जातक धीरे-धीरे विश्वास बनाते हैं और एक स्थिर, व्यावहारिक संबंध चाहते हैं। वे अपने साथी की छोटी-छोटी जरूरतों का ध्यान रखते हैं।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Virgo natives build trust slowly and want a stable, practical relationship. They take care of their partner's smallest needs.
horoscopes.compatible: वृषभ, मकर, कर्क और वृश्चिक राशि वाले कन्या के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Taurus, Capricorn, Cancer and Scorpio are the most compatible signs for Virgo.
horoscopes.career: कन्या जातक चिकित्सा, अनुसंधान, लेखांकन, आईटी और खाद्य उद्योग में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं। उनका ध्यान विवरण और गुणवत्ता पर होता है।
horoscopes.career_en: Virgo natives excel in medicine, research, accounting, IT and the food industry. Their focus is on detail and quality.
horoscopes.career_paths: चिकित्सा, नर्सिंग, लेखांकन, अनुसंधान, आईटी, पत्रकारिता, पोषण और पर्यावरण विज्ञान।
horoscopes.career_paths_en: Medicine, nursing, accounting, research, IT, journalism, nutrition and environmental science.
horoscopes.health: कन्या जातकों को पेट और आंतों पर विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए। मानसिक चिंता से पाचन समस्याएं हो सकती हैं। ध्यान और स्वस्थ आहार आवश्यक है।
horoscopes.health_en: Virgo natives should pay special attention to the stomach and intestines. Mental worry can lead to digestive problems. Meditation and a healthy diet are essential.

horoscopes.name: तुला
horoscopes.summary: तुला राशि के जातक संतुलित, न्यायप्रिय और कूटनीतिक होते हैं।
horoscopes.summary_en: Libra natives are balanced, fair-minded and diplomatic.
horoscopes.about:
तुला राशि, शुक्र ग्रह द्वारा शासित वायु तत्व की राशि है जिसका प्रतीक तराजू है। तुला जातक अपनी न्यायप्रियता, सौंदर्यबोध और कूटनीतिक स्वभाव के लिए जाने जाते हैं। ये हर स्थिति में संतुलन खोजते हैं।

इस राशि के लोग सामाजिक, आकर्षक और दूसरों के साथ सामंजस्य बनाने में कुशल होते हैं।
horoscopes.about_en:
Libra is an air sign ruled by Venus, symbolised by the scales. Libra natives are known for their sense of justice, aesthetic sense and diplomatic nature. They seek balance in every situation.

People of this sign are social, charming and skilled at creating harmony with others.
negative: दूसरों को खुश करने की प्रवृत्ति
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में तुला जातक रोमांटिक, समर्पित और अपने रिश्ते में संतुलन बनाए रखने वाले होते हैं। वे एक बौद्धिक और आकर्षक साथी की तलाश करते हैं।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Libra natives are romantic, devoted and keep their relationship in balance. They look for an intellectual and attractive partner.
horoscopes.compatible: मिथुन, कुंभ, सिंह और धनु राशि वाले तुला के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Gemini, Aquarius, Leo and Sagittarius are the most compatible signs for Libra.
horoscopes.career: तुला जातक कानून, कूटनीति, फैशन, कला और परामर्श में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं। उनकी न्यायप्रियता और सौंदर्यबोध उन्हें सफल बनाती है।
horoscopes.career_en: Libra natives excel in law, diplomacy, fashion, the arts and counselling. Their sense of justice and aesthetics makes them successful.
horoscopes.career_paths: वकालत, न्यायपालिका, फैशन डिजाइन, कला, परामर्श, मध्यस्थता और कूटनीति।
horoscopes.career_paths_en: Advocacy, the judiciary, fashion design, art, counselling, mediation and diplomacy.
horoscopes.health: तुला जातकों को गुर्दों और पीठ के निचले हिस्से पर विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए। संतुलित जीवनशैली और स्वस्थ आहार आवश्यक है।
horoscopes.health_en: Libra natives should pay special attention to the kidneys and lower back. A balanced lifestyle and healthy diet are essential.

horoscopes.name: वृश्चिक
horoscopes.summary: वृश्चिक राशि के जातक गहन, रहस्यमय और दृढ़ निश्चयी होते हैं।
horoscopes.summary_en: Scorpio natives are intense, mysterious and determined.
horoscopes.about:
वृश्चिक राशि, मंगल और प्लूटो द्वारा शासित जल तत्व की राशि है जिसका प्रतीक बिच्छू है। वृश्चिक जातक अपनी तीव्र भावनाओं, रहस्यमय व्यक्तित्व और अदम्य इच्छाशक्ति के लिए जाने जाते हैं। ये अत्यंत गहरे और जटिल होते हैं।

इस राशि के लोग परिवर्तन और पुनर्जन्म के प्रतीक हैं। इनकी सहज ज्ञान शक्ति असाधारण होती है।
horoscopes.about_en:
Scorpio is a water sign ruled by Mars and Pluto, symbolised by the scorpion. Scorpio natives are known for their intense emotions, mysterious personality and indomitable willpower. They are extremely deep and complex.

People of this sign are symbols of transformation and rebirth. Their intuitive power is extraordinary.
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में वृश्चिक जातक अत्यंत गहरे और तीव्र होते हैं। वे पूर्ण समर्पण और वफादारी चाहते हैं। उनके प्रेम में जुनून और गहराई होती है।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Scorpio natives are extremely deep and intense. They want complete devotion and loyalty. Their love is full of passion and depth.
horoscopes.compatible: कर्क, मीन, मकर और कन्या राशि वाले वृश्चिक के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Cancer, Pisces, Capricorn and Virgo are the most compatible signs for Scorpio.
horoscopes.career: वृश्चिक जातक जांच, अनुसंधान, चिकित्सा, मनोविज्ञान और वित्त में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं।
horoscopes.career_en: Scorpio natives excel in investigation, research, medicine, psychology and finance.
horoscopes.career_paths: जासूसी, शल्य चिकित्सा, मनोविज्ञान, वित्त, अनुसंधान, सेना और रहस्यमय विज्ञान।
horoscopes.career_paths_en: Detective work, surgery, psychology, finance, research, the armed forces and the occult sciences.
horoscopes.health: वृश्चिक जातकों को प्रजनन अंगों और उत्सर्जन तंत्र पर विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए। भावनात्मक तनाव को स्वस्थ तरीके से व्यक्त करना आवश्यक है।
horoscopes.health_en: Scorpio natives should pay special attention to the reproductive organs and excretory system. Expressing emotional stress in healthy ways is essential.

horoscopes.name: धनु
horoscopes.summary: धनु राशि के जातक आशावादी, साहसी और ज्ञान के खोजी होते हैं।
horoscopes.summary_en: Sagittarius natives are optimistic, adventurous seekers of knowledge.
horoscopes.about:
धनु राशि, बृहस्पति ग्रह द्वारा शासित अग्नि तत्व की राशि है जिसका प्रतीक धनुर्धर है। धनु जातक अपनी आशावादिता, स्वतंत्रता की चाह और दार्शनिक सोच के लिए जाने जाते हैं। ये विश्व घुमक्कड़ और सत्य के खोजी होते हैं।

इस राशि के लोग उत्साही, खुले विचारों वाले और हास्य से भरपूर होते हैं।
horoscopes.about_en:
Sagittarius is a fire sign ruled by Jupiter, symbolised by the archer. Sagittarius natives are known for their optimism, love of freedom and philosophical thinking. They are globetrotters and seekers of truth.

People of this sign are enthusiastic, open-minded and full of humour.
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में धनु जातक स्वतंत्रता और रोमांच चाहते हैं। वे एक ऐसे साथी की तलाश करते हैं जो उनके साथ जीवन के रोमांच में शामिल हो।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Sagittarius natives seek freedom and adventure. They look for a partner who will join them in life's adventures.
horoscopes.compatible: मेष, सिंह, तुला और कुंभ राशि वाले धनु के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Aries, Leo, Libra and Aquarius are the most compatible signs for Sagittarius.
horoscopes.career: धनु जातक शिक्षा, दर्शन, यात्रा, प्रकाशन और कानून में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं।
horoscopes.career_en: Sagittarius natives excel in education, philosophy, travel, publishing and law.
horoscopes.career_paths: शिक्षण, प्रकाशन, यात्रा उद्योग, दर्शन, कानून, मिशनरी कार्य और खेल।
horoscopes.career_paths_en: Teaching, publishing, the travel industry, philosophy, law, missionary work and sports.
horoscopes.health: धनु जातकों को कूल्हों और जांघों पर विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए। सक्रिय जीवनशैली और नियमित व्यायाम इनके लिए आवश्यक है।
horoscopes.health_en: Sagittarius natives should pay special attention to the hips and thighs. An active lifestyle and regular exercise are essential for them.

horoscopes.name: मकर
horoscopes.summary: मकर राशि के जातक महत्वाकांक्षी, अनुशासित और नवीन विचारों वाले होते हैं।
horoscopes.summary_en: Capricorn natives are ambitious, disciplined and full of fresh ideas.
horoscopes.about:
मकर राशि, शनि ग्रह द्वारा शासित पृथ्वी तत्व की राशि है जिसका प्रतीक समुद्री बकरी है। मकर जातक अपनी महत्वाकांक्षा, अनुशासन और व्यावहारिक सोच के लिए जाने जाते हैं। ये कठोर परिश्रम और धैर्य से अपने लक्ष्य प्राप्त करते हैं।

इस राशि के लोग जिम्मेदार, संगठित और दीर्घकालिक सफलता पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं।
horoscopes.about_en:
Capricorn is an earth sign ruled by Saturn, symbolised by the sea-goat. Capricorn natives are known for their ambition, discipline and practical thinking. They achieve their goals through hard work and patience.

People of this sign are responsible, organised and focused on long-term success.
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में मकर जातक धीरे-धीरे खुलते हैं लेकिन एक बार प्रतिबद्ध होने पर वे पूरी तरह समर्पित रहते हैं। वे एक स्थिर और सहायक साथी चाहते हैं।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Capricorn natives open up slowly, but once committed they are completely devoted. They want a stable and supportive partner.
horoscopes.compatible: वृषभ, कन्या, वृश्चिक और मीन राशि वाले मकर के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Taurus, Virgo, Scorpio and Pisces are the most compatible signs for Capricorn.
horoscopes.career: मकर जातक व्यवसाय, वित्त, प्रशासन और इंजीनियरिंग में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं।
horoscopes.career_en: Capricorn natives excel in business, finance, administration and engineering.
horoscopes.career_paths: व्यवसाय प्रबंधन, वित्त, इंजीनियरिंग, प्रशासन, राजनीति, चिकित्सा और वास्तुकला।
horoscopes.career_paths_en: Business management, finance, engineering, administration, politics, medicine and architecture.
horoscopes.health: मकर जातकों को हड्डियों, जोड़ों और दांतों पर विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए। अत्यधिक काम से बचना और आराम करना आवश्यक है।
horoscopes.health_en: Capricorn natives should pay special attention to the bones, joints and teeth. Avoiding overwork and getting rest is essential.

horoscopes.name: कुंभ
horoscopes.summary: कुंभ राशि के जातक नवीन विचारों वाले, स्वतंत्र और मानवतावादी होते हैं।
horoscopes.summary_en: Aquarius natives are innovative, independent and humanitarian.
horoscopes.about:
कुंभ राशि, शनि और यूरेनस द्वारा शासित वायु तत्व की राशि है जिसका प्रतीक जल वाहक है। कुंभ जातक अपनी अनूठी सोच, मानवतावादी दृष्टिकोण और स्वतंत्र भावना के लिए जाने जाते हैं। ये भविष्य की ओर देखने वाले होते हैं।

इस राशि के लोग समाज सुधारक, आविष्कारक और प्रगतिशील विचारक होते हैं।
horoscopes.about_en:
Aquarius is an air sign ruled by Saturn and Uranus, symbolised by the water-bearer. Aquarius natives are known for their unique thinking, humanitarian outlook and independent spirit. They are forward-looking.

People of this sign are social reformers, inventors and progressive thinkers.
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में कुंभ जातक मित्रता और बौद्धिक समझ को प्राथमिकता देते हैं। वे एक ऐसे साथी चाहते हैं जो उनकी स्वतंत्रता का सम्मान करे।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Aquarius natives prioritise friendship and intellectual understanding. They want a partner who respects their independence.
horoscopes.compatible: मिथुन, तुला, मेष और धनु राशि वाले कुंभ के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Gemini, Libra, Aries and Sagittarius are the most compatible signs for Aquarius.
horoscopes.career: कुंभ जातक प्रौद्योगिकी, विज्ञान, समाज सेवा और मीडिया में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं।
horoscopes.career_en: Aquarius natives excel in technology, science, social service and media.
horoscopes.career_paths: विज्ञान, प्रौद्योगिकी, समाज सेवा, पत्रकारिता, आविष्कार, खगोल विज्ञान और मानव अधिकार।
horoscopes.career_paths_en: Science, technology, social service, journalism, invention, astronomy and human rights.
horoscopes.health: कुंभ जातकों को टखनों और परिसंचरण तंत्र पर विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए। नियमित व्यायाम और मानसिक विश्राम आवश्यक है।
horoscopes.health_en: Aquarius natives should pay special attention to the ankles and circulatory system. Regular exercise and mental relaxation are essential.

horoscopes.name: मीन
horoscopes.summary: मीन राशि के जातक सहानुभूतिपूर्ण, कल्पनाशील और आत्मीय होते हैं।
horoscopes.summary_en: Pisces natives are empathetic, imaginative and warm-hearted.
horoscopes.about:
मीन राशि, बृहस्पति और नेपच्यून द्वारा शासित जल तत्व की राशि है जिसका प्रतीक दो मछलियाँ हैं। मीन जातक अपनी गहरी सहानुभूति, कल्पनाशीलता और आध्यात्मिक संवेदनशीलता के लिए जाने जाते हैं। ये अत्यंत सहज और संवेदनशील होते हैं।

इस राशि के लोग कलाकार, स्वप्नद्रष्टा और आध्यात्मिक साधक होते हैं।
horoscopes.about_en:
Pisces is a water sign ruled by Jupiter and Neptune, symbolised by two fish. Pisces natives are known for their deep empathy, imagination and spiritual sensitivity. They are extremely intuitive and sensitive.

People of this sign are artists, dreamers and spiritual seekers.
horoscopes.love: प्रेम में मीन जातक रोमांटिक, भक्तिपूर्ण और अपने साथी के साथ गहरा आत्मीय संबंध बनाते हैं। वे एक संवेदनशील और समझदार साथी चाहते हैं।
horoscopes.love_en: In love, Pisces natives are romantic and devoted, and form a deep soulful bond with their partner. They want a sensitive and understanding partner.
horoscopes.compatible: कर्क, वृश्चिक, वृषभ और मकर राशि वाले मीन के लिए सबसे अनुकूल होते हैं।
horoscopes.compatible_en: Cancer, Scorpio, Taurus and Capricorn are the most compatible signs for Pisces.
horoscopes.career: मीन जातक कला, संगीत, चिकित्सा, आध्यात्मिकता और सामाजिक कार्य में उत्कृष्ट होते हैं।
horoscopes.career_en: Pisces natives excel in the arts, music, medicine, spirituality and social work.
horoscopes.career_paths: कला, संगीत, नृत्य, चिकित्सा, मनोविज्ञान, आध्यात्मिक शिक्षण, फोटोग्राफी और धर्मार्थ कार्य।
horoscopes.career_paths_en: Art, music, dance, medicine, psychology, spiritual teaching, photography and charitable work.
horoscopes.health: मीन जातकों को पैरों और लसीका तंत्र पर विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए। भावनात्मक स्वास्थ्य के लिए ध्यान और रचनात्मक अभिव्यक्ति आवश्यक है।
horoscopes.health_en: Pisces natives should pay special attention to the feet and lymphatic system. Meditation and creative expression are essential for emotional health.

nakshatras.name: Ashwini
nakshatras.summary: Ashwini nakshatra marks the beginning of the zodiac journey in Vedic astrology, symbolized by a horse's head, representing speed, power, and pioneering spirit. It spans from 0°00′ to 13°20′ in Aries and is ruled by Ketu, giving natives a mystical and spiritual inclination combined with dynamic energy. The presiding deities are the Ashwini Kumars, the divine twin horsemen who are celestial physicians.
nakshatras.career: Natives excel in medical fields, emergency services, sports, military, veterinary sciences, and any profession requiring quick decision-making and leadership skills.
nakshatras.relationships: They are passionate partners but may be impulsive in relationships. They need partners who can match their energy and understand their independent nature.
nakshatras.finance: Generally good at accumulating wealth through their initiatives. They should avoid impulsive investments and focus on stable long-term financial planning.
nakshatras.health: Generally healthy but prone to head injuries, accidents, and stress-related issues. Regular exercise and meditation are beneficial.
nakshatras.spiritual: Each nakshatra carries deep spiritual significance in Vedic astrology, representing different aspects of cosmic consciousness and human evolution. Ashwini natives are blessed with the healing touch of the Ashwini Kumars.

nakshatras.name: Bharani
nakshatras.summary: Bharani nakshatra is ruled by Venus and presided over by Yama, the god of death and dharma. It represents the cycle of life, death, and rebirth. Natives of this nakshatra are known for their creative power, discipline, and ability to handle the extremes of life. They are carriers of new life and ideas.
traits: Strong sense of duty and dharma
nakshatras.career: Arts, entertainment, fashion design, medicine, law, finance, and any field requiring deep passion and creative vision.
nakshatras.relationships: Deeply loyal and passionate partners. They seek intense connections and can struggle with boundaries. Strong attraction to opposite natures.
nakshatras.finance: Generally accumulate wealth but must avoid overindulgence. Venus influence brings love for luxury — budgeting is key.
nakshatras.health: Strong constitution. Prone to reproductive issues and excess indulgence. Balance in lifestyle maintains good health.
nakshatras.spiritual: Bharani represents the creative force of the universe — Shakti. It teaches that transformation through discipline leads to spiritual growth and liberation.

nakshatras.name: Krittika
nakshatras.summary: Krittika is the third nakshatra, ruled by the Sun and presided over by Agni, the god of fire. This nakshatra spans across both Aries and Taurus and is associated with purification, courage, and the ability to cut through illusions. Natives are sharp, critical, and possess great inner strength.
nakshatras.career: Military, surgery, cooking, metallurgy, administration, politics, and spiritual teaching.
nakshatras.relationships: Protective and caring but can be demanding. Expect high standards from partners. May struggle with controlling tendencies.
nakshatras.finance: Disciplined with money but prone to sudden expenses. Conservative investments work best.
nakshatras.health: Strong digestion and metabolism. Prone to fevers and inflammation. Fire-related ailments.
nakshatras.spiritual: Krittika is the nakshatra of Agni — the sacred fire that purifies and transforms. It teaches discrimination and the courage to cut away what no longer serves.

nakshatras.name: Rohini
nakshatras.summary: Rohini is considered the most auspicious nakshatra in Vedic astrology. Ruled by the Moon, it is the Moon's favorite nakshatra where it is most exalted. Governed by Brahma the creator, Rohini natives possess exceptional beauty, creative talent, and material abundance.
nakshatras.career: Arts, music, fashion, agriculture, real estate, design, culinary arts, and any aesthetic profession.
nakshatras.relationships: Romantic, devoted, and sensual partners. Strongly attached and loyal but may become possessive or jealous.
nakshatras.finance: Naturally attract wealth and resources. Excellent taste leads to luxury spending — savings discipline needed.
nakshatras.health: Generally robust. Prone to throat issues, weight gain, and reproductive concerns. Grounding practices help.
nakshatras.spiritual: Rohini is where the Moon finds its highest expression — fertility, creativity, and nourishment. The nakshatra of manifestation and divine abundance.

nakshatras.name: Mrigashira
nakshatras.summary: Mrigashira means 'Deer's Head' and represents the eternal seeker. Ruled by Mars and presided over by Soma, the Moon God, natives of this nakshatra are curious, restless, and forever searching for the truth. They are gentle yet alert, always looking for something beyond the horizon.
nakshatras.career: Research, writing, communication, travel, exploration, gemology, hospitality, and philosophy.
nakshatras.relationships: Romantic and idealistic in love. Always searching for the perfect partner. Enjoy intellectual stimulation in relationships.
nakshatras.finance: Need stability in finances as restlessness can lead to inconsistency. Diverse investments suit them well.
nakshatras.health: Prone to nervous system issues and joint pains. Meditation and gentle exercise very beneficial.
nakshatras.spiritual: Mrigashira embodies the divine search — the soul's eternal quest for truth and beauty. The seeker who finds God in the journey itself.

nakshatras.name: Ardra
nakshatras.summary: Ardra means 'moist' or 'fresh' and is associated with storms, transformation, and profound change. Ruled by Rahu and presided over by Rudra, natives of this nakshatra experience intense life events that ultimately lead to deep wisdom and renewal. Like a storm that clears the air, Ardra brings purification.
nakshatras.career: Science, research, politics, psychology, philosophy, technology, and crisis management.
nakshatras.relationships: Deep, transformative connections. Need partners who can handle intensity and provide stability during emotional storms.
nakshatras.finance: Financial ups and downs are common. Rahu's influence creates sudden gains and losses. Steady planning essential.
nakshatras.health: Prone to respiratory issues, sudden illnesses. Mental health care through mindfulness is important.
nakshatras.spiritual: Ardra is the nakshatra of Rudra — cosmic dissolution and renewal. True growth comes only after the storm. Embrace transformation as divine grace.

nakshatras.name: Punarvasu
nakshatras.summary: Punarvasu means 'return of the light' or 'becoming good again'. Ruled by Jupiter and presided over by Aditi, the mother of the gods, this nakshatra bestows optimism, renewal, and the ability to bounce back from adversity. Natives are philosophical, generous, and spiritually inclined.
nakshatras.career: Teaching, philosophy, religion, healing, counseling, travel, and humanitarian work.
nakshatras.relationships: Warm, generous, and forgiving partners. Value spiritual connection over physical. Capable of rekindling relationships.
nakshatras.finance: Jupiter's blessing brings financial growth through wisdom. Avoid over-generosity leading to financial strain.
nakshatras.health: Generally healthy constitution. Prone to digestive issues and water retention. Optimism itself is their medicine.
nakshatras.spiritual: Punarvasu is the light that returns after darkness. It teaches eternal optimism — the universe always offers a fresh start to those who surrender with faith.

nakshatras.name: Pushya
nakshatras.summary: Pushya is considered the most auspicious of all nakshatras in many traditions. Ruled by Saturn and presided over by Brihaspati, the divine teacher, Pushya bestows nourishment, wisdom, and the ability to sustain and nurture others. It is associated with abundance and spiritual authority.
nakshatras.career: Teaching, medicine, nutrition, social work, religious service, counseling, and agriculture.
nakshatras.relationships: Deeply caring and devoted. Place family above all. May suppress own needs for others — need to maintain boundaries.
nakshatras.finance: Saturn's discipline brings steady financial growth. Conservative but reliable approach to money management.
nakshatras.health: Need to avoid over-giving to the point of depletion. Prone to lung and chest issues. Routine healthcare essential.
nakshatras.spiritual: Pushya is the celestial nourisher — it feeds the soul with wisdom and the body with sustenance. To give unconditionally is its highest teaching.

nakshatras.name: Ashlesha
nakshatras.summary: Ashlesha means 'the entwiner' and is symbolized by a coiled serpent. Ruled by Mercury and presided over by the Naga serpent gods, this nakshatra bestows penetrating intelligence, strategic thinking, and the ability to see through illusions. Natives possess hypnotic charm and deep intuition.
nakshatras.career: Psychology, occult, law, politics, detective work, research, writing, and medicine.
nakshatras.relationships: Intense and complex. Deeply loyal once committed but struggle with trust. Can be emotionally manipulative.
nakshatras.finance: Sharp financial instincts. Ability to see opportunities others miss. Watch for unethical shortcuts.
nakshatras.health: Prone to digestive issues and mental stress. Kundalini practices and yoga are highly beneficial.
nakshatras.spiritual: Ashlesha is the kundalini nakshatra — the coiled serpent of divine energy awakening within. Master the lower serpent to awaken the higher wisdom.

nakshatras.name: Magha
nakshatras.summary: Magha is the nakshatra of royalty, ancestors, and authority. Ruled by Ketu and presided over by the Pitrs (ancestral spirits), Magha natives carry strong ancestral karma and are destined for positions of power and leadership. They have a regal bearing and natural authority.
nakshatras.career: Politics, administration, government, royalty, management, heritage work, and history.
nakshatras.relationships: Seek partners who respect their status and authority. Generous and protective but expect loyalty and respect in return.
nakshatras.finance: Money comes through positions of authority and family inheritance. Generous givers but must watch pride-driven spending.
nakshatras.health: Strong constitution. Heart and back issues due to Leo placement. Maintain active lifestyle.
nakshatras.spiritual: Magha connects us to our ancestors — the great chain of being that extends beyond our individual lives. Honor your roots to reach your highest potential.

nakshatras.name: Purva Phalguni
nakshatras.summary: Purva Phalguni is the nakshatra of pleasure, creativity, and the arts. Ruled by Venus and presided over by Bhaga, the god of delight, this nakshatra bestows exceptional talents in arts, entertainment, and social grace. Natives are charming, pleasure-loving, and naturally creative.
nakshatras.career: Performing arts, music, entertainment, fashion, luxury goods, hospitality, and beauty industry.
nakshatras.relationships: Romantic, passionate, and devoted. Love creates their world. May prioritize pleasure over practical considerations.
nakshatras.finance: Venus brings financial abundance through creative work. Watch for over-spending on luxury and entertainment.
nakshatras.health: Prone to overindulgence affecting heart health. Balance pleasure with discipline for good wellbeing.
nakshatras.spiritual: Purva Phalguni teaches that joy, beauty, and pleasure are sacred — they are the divine's way of experiencing itself through us. Celebrate life fully.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Phalguni
nakshatras.summary: Uttara Phalguni is the nakshatra of service, commitment, and practical creativity. Ruled by the Sun and presided over by Aryaman, the god of contracts and marriages, this nakshatra instills a deep sense of responsibility, service, and devotion to duty.
nakshatras.career: Medicine, social service, government, administration, teaching, and any organized helping profession.
nakshatras.relationships: Loyal, responsible partners who honor commitments. Seek stability and mutual support. Marriage is sacred to them.
nakshatras.finance: Steady financial growth through disciplined effort. Investment in service-oriented enterprises pays off.
nakshatras.health: Generally healthy but prone to overwork and stress. Regular rest and outdoor activities essential.
nakshatras.spiritual: Uttara Phalguni embodies the sacred covenant — the divine agreement between souls to serve and uplift each other. True fulfillment comes through devoted service.

nakshatras.name: Hasta
nakshatras.summary: Hasta means 'hand' and represents skillfulness, dexterity, and the ability to manifest with one's hands. Ruled by the Moon and presided over by Savitur, the creative sun deity, Hasta natives possess exceptional practical skills, healing abilities, and the capacity to turn vision into reality.
nakshatras.career: Healing arts, crafts, surgery, writing, communication, palmistry, and fine arts.
nakshatras.relationships: Charming, witty partners who are deeply caring. Can be playful in love. Need intellectual connection.
nakshatras.finance: Excel at business and skilled trades. Natural aptitude for practical financial management.
nakshatras.health: Good health overall. Prone to digestive issues and hands/arms conditions. Yoga and manual arts are healing.
nakshatras.spiritual: Hasta is the nakshatra of divine craftsmanship — the hands that hold healing and creation. What we do with our hands is our prayer to the universe.

nakshatras.name: Chitra
nakshatras.summary: Chitra means 'bright' or 'brilliant' and is the nakshatra of artistic brilliance, architecture, and magical creation. Ruled by Mars and presided over by Vishwakarma, the divine architect of the universe, Chitra natives have extraordinary aesthetic sense and the ability to create stunning beauty.
nakshatras.career: Architecture, design, fashion, jewelry, art, film, photography, and any creative field.
nakshatras.relationships: Attracted to beauty and charisma. Romantic and passionate. May have idealistic expectations of partners.
nakshatras.finance: Creative talents bring financial success. Mars drive ensures they pursue opportunities actively.
nakshatras.health: Strong physical constitution. Mars energy needs physical outlets. Watch for inflammation and accidents.
nakshatras.spiritual: Chitra is the nakshatra of divine beauty — the recognition that every soul is a brilliant jewel created by the cosmic architect. Find the art in everything.

nakshatras.name: Swati
nakshatras.summary: Swati means 'self-going' or 'independent' and is associated with the wind — free, moving, and purifying. Ruled by Rahu and presided over by Vayu, the wind god, Swati natives value freedom, independence, and flexibility above all else. They are diplomatic, adaptable, and naturally social.
nakshatras.career: Business, trade, diplomacy, law, politics, communication, and spiritual teaching.
nakshatras.relationships: Value independence in relationships. Need a partner who respects their space. Diplomatic and balanced in love.
nakshatras.finance: Natural business acumen and networking skills lead to financial success. Rahu brings unexpected gains.
nakshatras.health: Prone to wind/vata imbalances, skin issues. Breathing practices and grounding activities are beneficial.
nakshatras.spiritual: Swati is the wind-borne nakshatra — free, unattached, and all-pervading. It teaches the spiritual art of detachment: be in the world but not bound by it.

nakshatras.name: Vishakha
nakshatras.summary: Vishakha means 'forked branch' or 'two-branched' and represents the tension between goals and ambition. Ruled by Jupiter and presided over by Indra and Agni, this nakshatra gives powerful ambition, determination, and the drive to achieve any goal set. They are the ultimate achievers.
nakshatras.career: Leadership, politics, military, competitive sports, business, spiritual leadership, and law.
nakshatras.relationships: Passionate and intense. May struggle between desire and spiritual aspiration. Devoted once committed.
nakshatras.finance: Jupiter's grace brings prosperity through determination. May sacrifice financial security for ambition.
nakshatras.health: Prone to liver issues, over-exertion. Channeling Mars-like energy productively is essential for health.
nakshatras.spiritual: Vishakha is the nakshatra of divine aspiration — the soul's burning desire to reach its highest potential. Every ambition, when purified, becomes a prayer.

nakshatras.name: Anuradha
nakshatras.summary: Anuradha means 'following Radha' or 'success after Radha' and is the nakshatra of devotion, friendship, and perseverance. Ruled by Saturn and presided over by Mitra, the god of friendship and alliances, Anuradha natives are loyal friends, strategic thinkers, and devoted souls.
nakshatras.career: Research, occult sciences, medicine, psychology, spiritual counseling, and international business.
nakshatras.relationships: Deeply devoted partners who honor love above all. Scorpio depth makes relationships transformative and intense.
nakshatras.finance: Saturn's discipline ensures steady financial growth. Strategic long-term investments are favored.
nakshatras.health: Prone to digestive and emotional suppression issues. Emotional release through arts and therapy is healing.
nakshatras.spiritual: Anuradha follows the path of Radha — pure devotional love that transcends all obstacles. True friendship and devotion are the highest spiritual practices.

nakshatras.name: Jyeshtha
nakshatras.summary: Jyeshtha means 'the eldest' or 'the chief' and is the nakshatra of seniority, authority, and responsibility. Ruled by Mercury and presided over by Indra, the king of gods, Jyeshtha natives bear great responsibilities and possess the mental brilliance to handle complex situations.
nakshatras.career: Leadership positions, psychology, occult, politics, military command, research, and writing.
nakshatras.relationships: Deeply protective and intense partners. May struggle with vulnerability. Loyalty is absolute once committed.
nakshatras.finance: Mercury brilliance brings financial intelligence. Can earn well but may overspend to maintain status.
nakshatras.health: Prone to digestive issues and stress-related conditions. The weight of responsibility affects health.
nakshatras.spiritual: Jyeshtha is the nakshatra of the elder — the one who leads by example and bears the burden of others' liberation. True leadership is sacred service.

nakshatras.name: Mula
nakshatras.summary: Mula means 'root' or 'foundation' and is associated with going to the very core of things, often through destruction of surface layers. Ruled by Ketu and presided over by Nirriti, the goddess of dissolution, Mula natives are drawn to the deepest truths and are often agents of transformation.
traits: Can initiate dissolution for new growth
nakshatras.career: Research, philosophy, occult sciences, ayurveda, herbalism, investigation, and spiritual teaching.
nakshatras.relationships: Intense and transformative connections. May experience upheaval in relationships that ultimately leads to growth.
nakshatras.finance: Financial instability may occur, but Sagittarius energy ultimately attracts abundance through philosophy.
nakshatras.health: Root-related health issues. Lower back, hips. Grounding practices and connection to nature are essential.
nakshatras.spiritual: Mula teaches that only by going to the root — the core of our being — can we find true liberation. Dissolution of the false is the birth of the real.

nakshatras.name: Purva Ashadha
nakshatras.summary: Purva Ashadha means 'early victory' and is associated with invincibility and the purifying power of water. Ruled by Venus and presided over by Apas, the deity of water, this nakshatra bestows a warrior spirit, philosophical idealism, and the power to purify and refresh all situations.
nakshatras.career: Philosophy, teaching, writing, law, medicine, sports, military, and inspirational speaking.
nakshatras.relationships: Idealistic in love. Seek a partner who shares their philosophical vision. Passionate and devoted.
nakshatras.finance: Venus brings creative earning potential. Philosophical nature should not block practical financial decisions.
nakshatras.health: Prone to hip and thigh issues. Outdoor activities and philosophical engagement maintain vitality.
nakshatras.spiritual: Purva Ashadha carries the invincibility of truth — that which cannot be defeated. Align with dharma and you become unstoppable.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Ashadha
nakshatras.summary: Uttara Ashadha means 'later victory' — the lasting, enduring victory that comes through patience and righteousness. Ruled by the Sun and presided over by the Vishwadevas (universal gods), this nakshatra bestows unshakeable dharmic principles, leadership, and the ability to achieve lasting success.
nakshatras.career: Administration, politics, military, judiciary, philosophy, and any position requiring integrity and authority.
nakshatras.relationships: Deeply committed and responsible partners. Seek meaningful, lasting relationships built on mutual respect.
nakshatras.finance: Slow but sure financial growth through righteous means. Saturn-Capricorn influence rewards patience.
nakshatras.health: Strong constitution but prone to knee and joint issues. Consistent exercise and discipline maintain health.
nakshatras.spiritual: Uttara Ashadha embodies the ultimate victory — the triumph of dharma over time. True success serves not just the self, but the entire world.

nakshatras.name: Shravana
nakshatras.summary: Shravana means 'hearing' and is the nakshatra of listening, learning, and the transmission of sacred knowledge. Ruled by the Moon and presided over by Vishnu, the preserver, Shravana natives are exceptional listeners, learners, and preservers of wisdom and tradition.
traits: Ability to preserve and transmit knowledge
nakshatras.career: Music, education, counseling, management, journalism, religious service, and knowledge transmission.
nakshatras.relationships: Devoted, traditional partners who value family. Listen deeply to partners. May be overly accommodating.
nakshatras.finance: Vishnu's grace brings steady abundance. Conservative and careful approach protects and grows wealth.
nakshatras.health: Prone to ear and hearing issues. Moon's influence affects mental health — emotional nurturing is essential.
nakshatras.spiritual: Shravana is the nakshatra of divine listening — the capacity to hear the voice of the cosmos. In stillness and receptivity, all wisdom is revealed.

nakshatras.name: Dhanishtha
nakshatras.summary: Dhanishtha means 'most famous' or 'most wealthy' and is associated with rhythm, music, and the abundance of the cosmos. Ruled by Mars and presided over by the eight Vasus, the elemental gods, Dhanishtha natives have strong drives for both material success and spiritual freedom.
nakshatras.career: Music, entertainment, science, technology, finance, medicine, and any innovative field.
nakshatras.relationships: Independent yet generous partners. May prioritize career and ambitions over relationships. Need space and freedom.
nakshatras.finance: Dhanishtha (wealthy) name reflects financial potential. Mars drive combined with Aquarian innovation brings abundance.
nakshatras.health: Prone to blood disorders and overexertion. Regular physical activity and music are therapeutic.
nakshatras.spiritual: Dhanishtha is the cosmic music — the celestial rhythm that holds the universe in perfect order. Align your actions with the universal rhythm and abundance follows.

nakshatras.name: Shatabhisha
nakshatras.summary: Shatabhisha means 'hundred physicians' and is associated with healing, mysticism, and the vast cosmic void. Ruled by Rahu and presided over by Varuna, the god of cosmic waters and divine law, Shatabhisha natives are natural healers, philosophers, and explorers of hidden realms.
nakshatras.career: Medicine, healing arts, astrology, technology, research, meditation, and occult sciences.
nakshatras.relationships: Deeply private and may seem emotionally distant. Need a patient partner who respects their solitude.
nakshatras.finance: Rahu brings unusual financial opportunities. Independent means of earning through innovation.
nakshatras.health: Prone to chronic conditions. Holistic healing and alternative medicine particularly beneficial for these natives.
nakshatras.spiritual: Shatabhisha is the physician of the cosmos — one who heals the collective wound. In service to all life, the healer finds their own liberation.

nakshatras.name: Purva Bhadrapada
nakshatras.symbol: Sword/Two front legs of funeral cot
nakshatras.summary: Purva Bhadrapada is a nakshatra of spiritual fire, transformation, and the courage to face darkness. Ruled by Jupiter and presided over by Aja Ekapada, this nakshatra bestows fierce spiritual aspiration, the power to transform negativity, and a deep longing for liberation.
traits: Can channel both light and dark
nakshatras.career: Philosophy, spiritual teaching, occult, healing, astrology, research, and social reform.
nakshatras.relationships: Unconventional and intense partners. May struggle between worldly love and spiritual aspiration. Deep soul connections.
nakshatras.finance: Jupiter's wisdom brings wealth through philosophical and spiritual pursuits. Avoid extremism in finances.
nakshatras.health: Prone to nervous system issues and extremes. Spiritual practice is the primary medicine for these natives.
nakshatras.spiritual: Purva Bhadrapada carries the sacred fire of transformation — the lightning that purifies. Walk the razor's edge between worlds, and find God in the depths.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Bhadrapada
nakshatras.symbol: Snake in water/Back legs of funeral cot
nakshatras.summary: Uttara Bhadrapada is the nakshatra of deep wisdom, spiritual depth, and compassionate service to all. Ruled by Saturn and presided over by Ahir Budhnya, the serpent of the cosmic ocean, this nakshatra bestows profound insight, compassion, and the ability to carry others through the depths.
nakshatras.career: Spiritual guidance, counseling, medicine, philosophy, research, and humanitarian work.
nakshatras.relationships: Deeply compassionate and devoted partners. See the divine in their partner. May sacrifice too much for love.
nakshatras.finance: Saturn ensures steady growth. Wisdom brings financial stability. Not motivated by money — but it follows their service.
nakshatras.health: Prone to feet and lymphatic system issues. Deep rest and spiritual practice maintain vitality.
nakshatras.spiritual: Uttara Bhadrapada holds the wisdom of the cosmic serpent — the kundalini that ascends to universal consciousness. Depth of being is the path to liberation.

nakshatras.name: Revati
nakshatras.summary: Revati is the final nakshatra of the zodiac, representing completion, transcendence, and the return of the soul to the cosmic ocean. Ruled by Mercury and presided over by Pushan, the nurturer and guide of souls, Revati natives carry the wisdom of all 27 nakshatras and radiate deep compassion.
nakshatras.career: Healing arts, music, spiritual teaching, social work, marine biology, and any nurturing profession.
nakshatras.relationships: Unconditionally loving and devoted. May idealize partners. Need gentle, spiritually attuned companions.
nakshatras.finance: Spiritual orientation can make finances secondary. Mercury helps with practical financial management.
nakshatras.health: Prone to feet issues and psychic sensitivity. Grounding practices and time in nature are essential.
nakshatras.spiritual: Revati is the cosmic completion — where the individual soul dissolves into universal consciousness. Every ending is the universe gathering itself for a new beginning.
